capabilities: convert statutes, case numbers and journal references into markdown links
choose provider priority separately for state and federal laws
search and filter known German laws in a sidebar
optionally re-link a note each time it is loaded
extras: README is written in German; the author asks for donations via Buy Me a Coffee; correct citation syntax rules are strict and documented with many examples.
problem: Obsidian cannot detect statutes, court case numbers or journal references in notes and turn them into links to online legal databases.

relations.evidence: Martin (@S1SYPHOS), der bereits ein Programm auf PHP-Basis schrieb, um Gesetze auf Webseiten zu verlinken

summary: Converts German legal citations in notes into markdown links to legal providers such as Dejure, Buzer and LexMea, and adds a law search sidebar.
